{{Top|leg}}
The '''Committee on Starfighter Acquisition and Maintenance''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] organization that oversaw the Alliance's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] acquisition program. The organization was so important that it was headed by the [[Minister of War (Alliance)/Legends|Minister of War]] himself, and included the [[Minister of Supply/Legends|Minister of Supply]], the [[Minister of Industry/Legends|Minister of Industry]], the [[Minister of Finance (Alliance)/Legends|Minister of Finance]], along with a number of ace [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commanders]].
